stories.title: Sponsorship sign applications submitted for around 20 Flintshire roundabouts
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has been asked to approve sponsorship signs at around 20 roundabouts across the county. The applications are part of the council’s Roundabout Portfolio Sponsorship scheme, which the council says is managed on its behalf by Outdo Media, an outdoor advertising company. stories.title: Wrong-way driving “on the increase” near Deeside Community Hospital one-way road, councillor says
stories.summary: Drivers are going the wrong way down a one-way road near Deeside Community Hospital and using it as a “short cut”, a Flintshire councillor has said. stories.title: Older people in Flintshire urged to claim £100m in unclaimed Pension Credit, Age Cymru says
stories.summary: Age Cymru is urging older people in Flintshire and across Wales to check what financial support they are entitled to, as the charity launches its annual guide for pensioners. stories.title: RCN Wales calls on new Welsh Government to grow nursing workforce as survey warns of “high risk” of harm
stories.summary: Nursing staff in Wales say staffing levels are not matching the complexity of care patients now need, with too many shifts operating without enough registered nurses to deliver safe and effective care, the Royal College of Nursing says. stories.title: New parents in Flintshire urged to claim Child Benefit as soon as baby’s birth is registered
stories.summary: HMRC is urging new parents in Flintshire and across the UK to claim Child Benefit as soon as their baby’s birth is registered, after new figures showed around a third do not claim before their child’s first birthday.
